purpose: Accuracy rejection test after the fixed-global-rank composition failure; no speed optimization
hypothesis: Compositional local singlet states with quantum Coulomb links can retain correlation across independent and coupled fragments
local_space: Complete two-electron singlet space in each orthogonal local orbital block, represented by paired determinants
global_space: Tensor product of neutral local singlets; exact projected direct/exchange couplings, no local charge-transfer or triplet sectors
partition: Supplied atom groups, symmetrically orthogonalized AO order; no fitted energy offsets
reference: New full cc-pVDZ singlet four-electron CUDA matrix-free reference, after prediction
reference_initialization: HF singlet plus one fixed small generic singlet component, to avoid locking the reference to an incorrect spatial irrep
assessment: All cases retained, no energy-label fitting, rank/seed/iteration sweep or replacement. Require per-case errors and the balanced H4 geometry contrast below 1 kcal/mol. A failure closes the neutral-singlet-only hypothesis before any speed work.
limits: Early rejection panel, not full GMTKN55
State projection, not yet a density-only XC functional
